svg.title: The real-fault rig: five servers, 68 fault classes, 79 invariants

g.text: Five servers get real faults, and a checker reads the logs
The rig tests what a simulation cannot: real kernels and TCP, SIGKILL during a write, OOM, cgroups, disks and clocks.
One night on five bare-metal servers
79 invariants, examined from the logs only
the epoch of a key's writes never decreases
the store keeps each write that it confirmed
a stream does not skip or repeat a record
each call gets a reply in 5 lease periods after a heal
